title: Does Medicare Cover Online Therapy? Yes, Through 2027 (Which Apps Take It)
description:
Medicare Part B covers therapy by video from home through at least Dec 31, 2027. What you pay, which online platforms take Medicare, and what to check before open enrollment ends Dec 7, 2026.

Key facts:
• Medicare Part B covers therapy by video from home, at the same price as in person, through at least Dec 31, 2027 (Medicare.gov; Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026)
• Original Medicare: 20% of the Medicare-approved amount after the Part B deductible, $283 in 2026 (CMS)
• Talkspace and Talkiatry say they take Original Medicare; Headspace works through select Medicare Advantage plans; BetterHelp says Medicare isn't accepted (each company's own help pages, checked Nov 2026)
• Open enrollment runs Oct 15 - Dec 7, 2026; changes take effect Jan 1, 2027

Sources: https://www.medicare.gov/coverage/telehealth · https://www.cms.gov/newsroom/fact-sheets/2026-medicare-parts-b-premiums-deductibles · https://www.medicare.gov/health-drug-plans/open-enrollment

Full guide: https://www.treatmentshub.com/online-therapy/articles/does-medicare-cover-online-therapy

Important:
• The presenter in this video is AI-generated.
• TreatmentsHub is a comparison site, not a medical provider. This is general information, not medical advice.
• Prescription treatment needs an evaluation by a licensed clinician, who decides whether it's right for you.
• Online therapy isn't an emergency service. In a crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.
• Platform policies change; confirm coverage with your plan or 1-800-MEDICARE.
